Name: Dino Velociraptor Reskin for Alternative Textures
Author: counterklock
Description:
[size=5][b]ABOUT:[/b][/size]

A conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/825]Zynonia's velociraptor skin replacements[/url] for dinosaurs to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures.[/url]﻿

[size=5][b]KEYWORDS [/b][/size]
Updated: 3/10/22

All raptors have been tagged with my prefix, the original mod creator's name, velociraptor, and color.

[code]|| Main
 CK - All of my AT content is tagged with 'CK' - Short for 'Counterklock'
 Zynonia - All raptors are tagged with the original mod creator's name
 Velociraptor - To differentiate your raptors from other dinosaur skins you might have

|| Colors
 Brown
 Blue
 Albino
 Green
 Grey
 Pink
 Sand
 Tan
[/code]
[b][size=5]NOTES:[/size]
[/b]This content pack has been tested with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4015]BFAV version of Velociraptors[/url], but it acts weird, probably due to the fact that the BFAV version makes it so dinosaur eggs hatch both dinosaurs (ie. the thing this pack retextures) and velociraptors (ie. a new category of animal defined by BFAV). AT content packs target specific object categories; in this case, this mod targets the 'dinosaur' category.

Use at your own discretion, but I'd advise picking one or the other. I may throw together a BFAV compatible version if you'd rather have separate vanilla dinosaurs and BFAV raptors, depending on feedback.
[b]
[size=5][b]CREDITS:[/b][/size][/b]
Zynonia for the original raptor textures
